Building a DIY Water Filter System for Stray Cats Our stray cats were drinking from a filthy ditch - full of bugs and stagnant rainwater. So we built them a natural, multi-stage water filtration system using clay pots, volcanic rock, sponges, and a solar-powered pump! With aquatic plants, a mini fish pond, and a cozy shaded pavilion, the place transformed into a peaceful oasis where our rescue cats can safely hydrate, play, and nap. We even welcomed new kittens from kind fans who knew we'd give them a better life. Watching the cats thrive in a space made with love and care is the most rewarding part of rescue work. This DIY system isn't just clean - it's beautiful, sustainable, and full of life. 🐾🌿💧 Let's show the world that stray cats deserve dignity too. 🐱💙 #StrayCats #CatRescue #DIYWaterFilter #Catlovers #CatVlog #AnimalLovers #Cats #straycat #PetCare #TikTokCats #CatsOfTikTok #CatTok #FYP #ViralVideo #Cutecats
